tools.name: list_situations
tools.description: The situation keys and names Situation follows: Iran and the Strait of Hormuz, Ukraine and Russia, US Debt and Currency, the Plague Tracker, Weather, and AI and Hacking.

tools.name: get_wire
tools.description: The newest lines on a situation's wire, newest first, each with its source and its source time.

tools.name: get_map_events
tools.description: The events the map draws for a situation: the place, what kind of place it is, and the time of the line that named it.

tools.name: get_stories
tools.description: The stories of the last 24 hours: what broke first, who broke it, how many lines it has and whether one source has it alone.

tools.name: get_data
tools.description: One of the /data series as text: wire-volume, hormuz-air-traffic or roster-members.

tools.name: subscribe_daily
tools.description: Send the confirm email for Situation Daily to an address new to Situation. The subscription starts only when the reader clicks the link in it. A reader who already has an account turns Daily on in the account menu.

tools.name: get_live
tools.description: Without confirmPaymentSpend this only answers the price: nothing is charged and nothing is opened. With confirmPaymentSpend: true it answers the Polar checkout link for that plan.
